Date them before
you date them.

why.title:
Dating got expensive.
In every sense.
why.p1: First dates now cost a hundred bucks before the second drink. And the price of being wrong is higher: a number you can't take back.
why.p2: There should be a step between matching and meeting. A safer one. There wasn't. Now there is.
why.bridge: One room. Works across every dating app.

story.quote: Not a video call. A date.

moods.title:
Eight backdrops.
One feeling.
moods.subtitle: Candlelit, moonlit, golden hour — the room paints itself around you.

steps.d: A six-digit code lands in your hand. Add an optional PIN if you want extra cover.
Drop it in any DM. The other side opens it on the app or in any browser.
Twenty minutes, an hour, whatever you booked. The room dissolves when you're done.

inside.title: Built for the part of dating that's actually hard: the first hour.
inside.subtitle: Awkward silences kill chemistry. The room comes with things to do.

cards.d: Real questions, not small talk. Two hundred and fifty prompts that get past the weather.
A YouTube clip, a stand-up set, a trailer. Synced down to the second.
Play her the song. Play him the song back. Watch each other react.
Rapid-fire choices. The fastest way to find out you both hate camping.
A photo of the two of you, taken at the same moment from two cities. The only thing you keep.
Couple-safe by default. Tiered, so you choose how brave the room gets.
The classic. Now with a partner who can't quite read your face through the candlelight.
Karaoke, the 36 Questions, Couple's Trivia, Draw and Guess. The next wave.

oneRoom.title: One room. Every app.
oneRoom.p1: Most daters keep three or four apps open at once. Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, all running at the same time. None of them will ever build a room that works across the others. DateRoom does.
oneRoom.p2: The room is yours. Drop the code in whichever DM matters tonight. The next match opens the same room. You bring the room. Matches come to it.

couples.title: A room that stays open.
couples.body: When you live in different cities. When one of you is on the road. When you live in the same house but the kids are everywhere. Keep a room. Pin a vision board. Leave each other notes. Watch a movie at the same time from two time zones. Make the walls yours. It stays open as long as you want it to.

friends.title: Closer than the group chat.
friends.body: Best friends in three different cities. Sisters in different countries. The book club that lives across time zones. Up to five of you in one room. Watch a movie at the same time. Play the deck. Argue about whose turn it is on the DJ. The group chat, but you can actually see each other.

finalCta.title: Open the door.

footer.mission: We're on a mission to bring intentionality and safety to the part of dating no one designed: the space between a match and a meeting.
footer.tagline: The room before the phone number.

date.title: The room before the number.
date.body: Drop a six-digit code in any DM. Twenty minutes or two hours. The room dissolves when you're done.

together.title: A room that stays open.

crew.title: Closer than the group chat.

hero.title:
Every room
is a date.
hero.subtitle: And every date deserves an invitation. A private code and PIN, no phone numbers swapped, opens on any phone or laptop. Inside: things to do together, and a chaperon if you would like one.

chaperon.title: A chaperon will be present, should you wish.
chaperon.body: Meeting someone new? Turn on Chaperon, our AI that keeps you company on the call. It quietly points out anything worth a second look, and only you see it. You decide whether your date is told it is there.
chaperon.protectBody: Looks out for you on a first date. Your first protected date is free.
chaperon.coachBody: Private nudges on pace and chemistry, while it is happening.
chaperon.also: Also on every date: no phone numbers swapped, a private code and PIN, report a concern in one tap, and a first-date room that closes when the date ends.
